META.about: For every record of dalil.json and dalil-gaps.json that copies or points at corpus bytes: where each copied field comes from. sha256 = sha256 of the whole source field as UTF-8 (the source record); copied_sha256 = sha256 of the bytes in the dalil record (a span [start, end) of the source field when 'span' is given; with 'omit', the span minus those running-head spans, each shown as an ellipsis; with 'source_truncated', followed by a space and an ellipsis). validate_waris.py recomputes both from the pinned inputs and api/data.
